title: 6 Kenilworth Square, Rathgar, Co. Dublin
description:
Occupying a distinguished position on one of Dublin 6 most sought-after residential squares, this exceptional Victorian residence presents a rare opportunity to enjoy elegant period living with every modern convenience. Beautifully restored and thoughtfully redesigned, the property seamlessly combines its original architectural character with luxurious contemporary finishes across generously proportioned accommodation.

Recently fully modernised and presented to the rental market furnished, the property offers four spacious double bedrooms, four bathrooms, two interconnected reception rooms, and an impressive open-plan ground floor incorporating living, kitchen and dining areas.

Behind its handsome red-brick facade, the property opens into a magnificent reception hall, where soaring ceilings, intricate decorative plasterwork, marble flooring and a striking chandelier immediately establish the exceptional character of the home. The elegant interconnecting reception rooms provide superb spaces for both formal entertaining and relaxed family living, featuring original marble fireplaces, bespoke joinery, crystal chandeliers and tall sash windows overlooking the mature gardens.

The accommodation has been designed with both luxury and modern family living in mind. A stunning library and home office features bespoke fitted cabinetry, while the formal drawing room enjoys a wonderful outlook over the landscaped gardens. The beautifully appointed living spaces are finished to an exceptional standard throughout, with careful attention given to both the period detailing and contemporary functionality.

The lower level has been expertly reimagined to provide an impressive range of lifestyle and practical amenities, including a bespoke under-stair wine display, fully fitted utility room, extensive storage and a dedicated home gym with direct access to the garden.

The property is also equipped with an impressive array of modern conveniences, ensuring every aspect of security and contemporary comfort has been considered. Security provisions include a monitored alarm system, CCTV, external sensor lighting and electric gates with remote camera access. Outdoor amenities include automatic garden lighting, an integrated irrigation system, an electric car charger, garden dining area and gas and charcoal barbecues. Inside, residents will enjoy underfloor heating with remote heating controls, a ceiling-integrated Sonos speaker system, multiple integrated TV/media systems, a home bar complete with wine and drinks fridge and ice maker, and seamless connectivity via a whole-home Wi-Fi mesh system. 

Outside, the landscaped gardens provide a private and tranquil setting, complemented by secure electric gates and valuable off-street parking an exceptionally desirable feature in this prestigious Dublin 6 location.

Location

Kenilworth Square enjoys an enviable residential setting within easy reach of Rathgar, Ranelagh and Rathmines. The surrounding area offers an excellent selection of boutique shops, artisan cafes, restaurants, bars and leisure amenities, while a wealth of parks, sporting facilities and recreational pursuits are close by.

The property is also exceptionally well positioned for access to Dublin city centre, with convenient transport links including nearby LUAS services and easy access to the citys principal road networks.

The area is particularly renowned for its excellent selection of schools, with many of Dublins most highly regarded educational institutions within easy reach, including:

Alexandra College

Gonzaga College

Sandford Park School

St Marys College

Stratford College

The High School, Rathgar

Rathgar Junior School

Kildare Place National School

A home of exceptional character and distinction, this magnificent residence combines elegant period proportions, original architectural features and luxurious contemporary living in one of Dublin 6 most prestigious and enduringly desirable addresses.

A truly exceptional furnished luxury residence on Kenilworth Square.
